rationale: The original short thesis relied on a rejection of the 5-minute 9-EMA and session VWAP, as well as breakdown continuation below the $10.04 session low. Instead, price held above the lows and just surged on a massive 1-minute volume spike (57,445 shares vs <7,500 on prior bars) to reclaim the 5-minute 9-EMA ($10.16) and reach session VWAP ($10.21). With SPY extending its rally to +2.12% and buyers stepping in aggressively, the short edge is broken and closing now avoids a likely stop-out at $10.30.
